name: button
title: Button
description: The Mantis button, measured from the reference product: white default (everyday confirm/save), lime brand (the one main call to action: generate, sign up, buy a plan), lime tint, secondary, glass, soft, outline, ghost, destructive, commerce pink and commerce blue looks; flat, raised (chunky CTA edge) and glossy (generate) depths; 24–52px sizes. Hover dims to 80% and press to 60% brightness.
